correctness.rationale: The exact finite proof constructs all 17,373 augmented faces, 8,682 acyclic matching pairs and its critical chain complex. The signed Morse differential has one primitive image and all other entries zero, yielding ranks 5 and 2. For each of 48 graph symmetries, integral gradient projection and lift produce valid homology characters, checked against all signed full-complex Lefschetz numbers; the degree-five character is additionally checked on a direct closed-cycle basis. Standard S4 character values give exactly the stated two degrees. Rational quotient homology uses the finite-group invariants theorem.

value.rationale: The 24-vertex truncated octahedron is a canonical Archimedean graph and the known mixed-dimensional Rips stage is a natural locus for equivariant questions. The new character separates two inequivalent fourth-degree constituents with different central reversal parity and identifies a unique fifth-degree invariant, yielding a new rational quotient-homology consequence not implied by the known 5/2 Betti table. No general or publication-sized theorem is claimed.
